info.title: Welcome to {app}!
info.subtitle: Your smart assistant for all your groceries.
info.featuresSubtitle: Discover everything you can do with our app
info.feature1Text: Create an unlimited number of grocery lists for any occasion. Add infinite products and keep everything organized in one place.
info.feature2Text: Easily share your lists with others. Collaborate in real-time and see instantly which groceries are already in the basket. Perfect for households!
info.feature3Text: Add your loyalty cards, receipts, or other important cards to the app. This way, you have everything at hand and never miss out again.
info.feature4Text: The app learns from your habits and provides smart suggestions for products you frequently buy. You'll never forget anything again.
info.feature5Text: All your lists, products, and cards are securely stored on your personal account. Available anytime, anywhere.
info.ctaSubtitle: Join {app} to organize shopping, share lists, and never miss an item.
info.screensIntro: Here's how it looks while managing lists, adding products and checking items off.
info.screenMobileText: Lists with prices, recipes and cook mode, family cookbooks, your loyalty cards and insight into your groceries: everything in one app.
info.crossPlatformIntro: Use {app} on PC, laptop, tablet (iPad) and phone. The responsive design adapts automatically.
info.pwaIntro: Use {app} on your phone, tablet and computer: everything stays in sync.
info.pwaDesktop: Computer: use this website in any browser, or install it as an app in Chrome or Edge (the install icon next to the address bar).
info.pwaAndroid: Android: download the app from this website; it shows step by step how to install it.
info.pwaIOS: iPhone and iPad: get the app in the App Store.
info.pwaUpdates: The website is always up to date; the app tells you itself when a new version is needed.
info.desktopText: Optimal layout for larger screens with quick access to your lists.
info.mobileText: Optimized touch interface with a bottom navigation bar.
info.tabletText: More space for lists and items in one overview.
info.downloadText: {app} is available for iPhone and Android, with recipes, cook mode, a home-screen widget and Apple Watch. Prefer the browser? This website works too.
info.featureRecipesText: Save your recipes, import them from any recipe site in the app, and collect them in cookbooks you share with family. Put the ingredients on your list in one tap.
info.featureCookText: Cook mode shows one step at a time. Start a timer on a step and the app lets you know when it's done, even with your phone locked.
info.featureWidgetText: See your list on your Home Screen, and check off products, show your loyalty cards and follow timers on your Apple Watch.
info.screensText: Prefer a big screen? Your lists, recipes and cookbooks are on this website too, always up to date with the app.
info.webListsTitle: All your lists at a glance
info.webListsText: See what is left on every list and who you share it with.
info.webListTitle: See right away what it costs
info.webListText: Prices per product and the total of your list, so you know what to expect at the checkout.
info.webRecipesText: Search by recipe or ingredient, filter by course, and switch between your cookbooks.
info.webRecipeText: Ingredients for the number of servings you need, the method step by step, and time, level and nutrition.
info.pwaIOSTestFlight: iPhone and iPad: install the app (now through TestFlight, the beta of the App Store).

support.title: Help & contact
support.subtitle: Answers to common questions, and how to reach us
support.contactText: Questions, problems or a request about your data? Send an email and you will get an answer as soon as possible.
support.q1: How do I share a list?
support.a1: Open the menu (⋮) of a list and choose Share. Enter the other person's email address: they get an invitation, also if they don't have an account yet.
support.q2: Where do I find an invitation?
support.a2: Invitations appear at the top of your lists screen. Accept one and the list is added to your lists.
support.a3: On the login screen, tap Forgot password. You'll get an email with a link to choose a new one.
support.q4: How do I add a loyalty card?
support.a4: Go to Cards and tap +. Take a photo of your card or type in its number, and the app makes a barcode you can show at the checkout.
support.q5: How do I turn notifications on or off?
support.a5: In the app: Profile → Notifications. Choose which updates about your lists you want to receive.
support.q6: How do I delete my account?
support.a6: From your profile you can delete your account yourself. This permanently removes your account, lists, cards and login history.

android.title: Shoplisto for Android
android.subtitle: Download the app straight from this website, without the Play Store.
android.step1: Open this page on your Android phone and tap "Download for Android".
android.step2: Open the downloaded file Shoplisto.apk (from the notification or your Downloads).
android.step3: The first time, Android asks whether your browser may install apps: allow it ("Install unknown apps").
android.step4: Tap "Install" and open Shoplisto. Log in, or create an account in the app.
android.warning: Because the app doesn't come from the Play Store, Android may show a warning. That's normal for apps installed this way.
android.updates: Small updates arrive in the app by themselves. For a bigger update, download the app here again and install it over the old one: you stay logged in.
android.unavailable: The Android app isn't available for download yet.
